blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how a simple push or pull can move heavy objects? Let's explore the world of forces and simple machines!

blocks.markdown: In our daily lives, we often encounter forces. A force is simply a push or a pull that can change the motion of an object. When you push a door open or pull a drawer, you are applying force.

blocks.title: Definition of Force
blocks.text: A force is any interaction that, when unopposed, will change the motion of an object. It can be a push or a pull.

blocks.markdown: Simple machines make our work easier by allowing us to apply less force over a greater distance. The three basic types of simple machines are levers, pulleys, and inclined planes.

items: Lever: A rigid bar that pivots around a fixed point called the fulcrum.
Pulley: A wheel with a groove that holds a rope or cable.
Inclined Plane: A flat surface set at an angle to help lift objects.

blocks.title: Example of a Lever
blocks.prompt: Identify a common lever used in a Nigerian home.

steps.text: Consider the action of using a broom to sweep the floor.
The broom acts as a lever with your hand as the fulcrum.

blocks.answer: A broom is a common lever used in Nigerian homes.

blocks.markdown: Understanding how these simple machines work can help us use them more effectively in our daily tasks.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Remember, in exams, you might be asked to identify or give examples of simple machines like levers, pulleys, and inclined planes.

points: A force is a push or a pull that changes the motion of an object.
Simple machines include levers, pulleys, and inclined planes, which help make work easier.
